test_cases.name: Singleton client verification
test_cases.input_setup: Import get_llm_runtime() across callers and invoke without request
test_cases.expected_result: Exact same instance ID on all invocations

test_cases.name: 45 s timeout enforcement
test_cases.input_setup: Mock LLM with delay exceeding configured timeout budget
test_cases.expected_result: TimeoutError raised cleanly at configured deadline; no silent retry
test_cases.evidence: Config default=45.0s; Timeout raised cleanly after 1.00s

test_cases.name: Zero hidden retries on 500
test_cases.expected_result: Exactly 1 request sent; exception propagated immediately
test_cases.evidence: Exactly 1 request executed; exception propagated: HTTP 500

test_cases.name: Client lifecycle on shutdown
test_cases.expected_result: aclose() called, client closed cleanly without resource leaks
test_cases.evidence: aclose() executed successfully, no resource leaks

test_cases.name: Concurrent reuse under load
test_cases.input_setup: 50 concurrent async tasks calling get_llm_runtime() simultaneously
test_cases.expected_result: Zero race condition, exact duplicate singleton ID across all 50 workers
test_cases.evidence: 50 concurrent async workers returned identical runtime id=140334351851632
